steps.en: Add the dependency to your docs app
Parse each document once, at build time
steps.zh: 构建期把每篇文档解析一次

steps.en: Return a plain-object AST you can cache as JSON, with executable URLs screened and raw HTML escaped
steps.zh: 返回可缓存为 JSON 的 AST，剔除危险 URL、转义原始 HTML

steps.en: Render the cached tree to an HTML string
steps.zh: 把缓存的树渲染成 HTML 字符串

steps.en: Consume the same tree without re-parsing — every renderer keeps one output contract
steps.zh: 不重新解析直接消费同一棵树，各渲染器共用一份输出契约

steps.en: Hand the same document to the React adapter
steps.zh: 把同一份文档交给 React 适配器

value.en: One parse feeds HTML, React, and Octane with identical output, in ~5-7 KB gzip entries with the safe defaults already applied
value.zh: 一次解析同时喂给 HTML、React、Octane，输出一致；约 5-7 KB gzip 入口，安全默认已生效
